# Document new options and features in the same PR

When a PR adds an option or a user-visible feature, update the docs in the same PR: explain the new options on the relevant docs page and say how the feature is turned on.

**Why:** Requested on 3 PRs by 3 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > Please, can you also add a section explaining new options in docs/api/browser/context.md
  — @sheremet-va on PR #9475: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9475#pullrequestreview-3671615747
- > This needs to be added in documentation too.
  — @AriPerkkio on PR #10119: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10119#pullrequestreview-4111657767
- > Probably first section or new section should mention the activation switch.
  — @hi-ogawa on PR #10113: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10113#discussion_r3179542895
